ios.desc:
Send a check in the mail—right from your phone.

No stamps, envelopes, or trips to the post office needed.

Check Supply makes it easy to mail physical checks anywhere in the U.S. Whether you're paying rent, a bill, or sending money to a friend, we handle printing, postage, and delivery for you.

Securely connect the bank account you'd like to pay from, enter the recipient's name and address, and your check will be printed and mailed—automatically.

Track your payments every step of the way. Get updates when your check is printed, shipped, and delivered.

Choose from multiple USPS shipping options including First-Class, Priority, Express, and Certified Mail.

No subscription required: pay per check sent. Or purchase a digital checkbook of 12 checks to save.

Perfect for:

Paying bills by mail
Mailing rent checks
Send a check by certified mail for legal reasons
Sending business or personal payments

Anyone who needs to mail a check, without the hassle

quotes.text:
I built https://check.supply with a friend - it’s an iOS app that is like a cash app experience for mailing a check.

Old school landlords, paying gardeners, or other people still only accepting checks. We use plaid to connect your account, then press send, then track the printing, mailing and delivery of the check.

Only iOS App here:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/check-supply/id6475490646
